$comment: SETS THE PROGRESSION ENGINE SKIPS, WITHOUT TOUCHING HIS LOG. Read by src/lib/gym/excluded-sets.ts and applied in
getExerciseHistories (src/lib/gym/db.ts), the one read behind the suggestion, the stall detector and the trend line.
The rows stay in gym_set exactly as he typed them, and every other read (the log page, /health, the year page) still
shows them. Same shape as HealthOS/disowned-sessions.json: a checked-in list of ids, reversible by deleting a line.
Add a row only for a set whose NUMBER cannot be what it says, with the evidence in `why`, and quote the row's
weight, reps and date so a reader can match it to the table without a query. Never edit or delete the gym_set row.
src/lib/gym/excluded-sets.test.ts asserts the shape and that the engine's answer for the lift moves when these go.

sets.why: Logged under the barbell RDL at 60 to 68 lb on a day his working weight there was 175 (175x6/8/6 on 2026-09-21), on a lift he had worked at 165 to 225 for six weeks. A TYPO, his answer on 2026-10-04: a dumbbell reading is impossible, and with about 60 numbers typed a session a slipped key is expected. The true weights are unknown, so the rows stay excluded rather than corrected. The engine had read them as a two-thirds drop and offered 68, then 65; the 2026-10-01 rows below followed that number. The ghost prefill shipped the same day cuts the typing that produced it.
Typed at 65 lb after the card suggested 68 off the 2026-09-28 rows above, so this session follows their number rather than measuring the barbell RDL. Excluded with 1685, whose typo it inherited.
